verdict.rationale: Unleash documents client/backend token types for SDK connectivity and GitHub states it supports 15 official client and server SDKs plus 15+ community SDKs, covering backend, web (frontend tokens explicitly noted as safe client-side), and implicitly mobile via client SDKs. Consistent flag behavior is reinforced through shared concepts (activation strategies, environments, variants) applying uniformly across SDK types. Missing for 10: explicit mobile SDK naming/examples and independent hands-on cross-platform consistency testing.
